contacts.name: Suresh (Apartment Plumber)
contacts.notes: Handles pipe leakages, PVC joints, water meter valve repairs and bathroom plumbing.

reviews.comment: Fixed PVC elbow joint leakage under kitchen sink. Arrived within 30 minutes.
Replaced broken bathroom tap and tested pressure. Reasonable charges.
Clean work on main water inlet valve.

contacts.name: Ramesh (Society Electrician)
contacts.notes: Handles phase changes, transformer fuses, meter board wiring, capacitor replacements.

reviews.comment: Replaced tripping MCB switch in flat electrical distribution board.
Very knowledgeable about society phase lines and inverter wiring.

contacts.name: Laxman (Building Watchman)
contacts.notes: On-site watchman. Coordinates water motor on/off, daily garbage collection, gate entry.

reviews.comment: Always punctual with turning on motor and daily garbage collection.
Very polite and helpful with packages.
Keeps gate area clean and safe.

contacts.name: Eagle Eye Security Services (Supervisor)
contacts.notes: Society security contract agency supervisor for guard shifts and night patrols.

contacts.name: Sri Sai Water Tankers (5,000L & 10,000L)
contacts.notes: Primary tanker supplier. Call by 7:00 AM for same-day sump replenishment.

contacts.name: Johnson Lifts & AMC Support
contacts.notes: Customer ID: ROCKCLIFF-B. Use helpline for immediate breakdown emergency rescue.

contacts.name: CRI Sump Motor & Submersible Mechanics
contacts.notes: Motor winding, starter coil repairs, automatic water level controller technician.

contacts.name: MCH Garbage Collector Team
contacts.notes: Daily door-to-door dry and wet waste pickup at 8:30 AM.

contacts.name: HMWSSB Water Supply Lineworker (Section 5)
contacts.notes: Hyderabad Water Board piped supply valve operator and water bill queries.

contacts.name: Society President (Flat 402)
contacts.notes: Rockcliff B-Block Association President. For general policy and grievance escalation.

contacts.name: Society Treasurer (Flat 204)
contacts.notes: Handles maintenance payment receipts, online bank transfers, and society accounts.

billing_config_history.notes: Initial B-Block Maintenance baseline prior to individual water meter setup.
Water meters commissioned for all 32 flats. Mandatory maintenance set to ₹1,400 and common power deduction fixed at ₹6,000.
